source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved Debug Port Table Configuration values persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults after Load Default while the intended firmware debug-table publication, endpoint routing, boot diagnostics and management recovery remain valid.
original_method: Change Debug Port Table fields in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC, collecting firmware, endpoint, boot and log evidence.
manual_activity: A human must operate the Debug Port Table Configuration page, perform both save/reboot phases, select Load Default and inspect firmware values. Automated table/endpoint capture is supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Exact AMD platform, board and BIOS identity
Named debug-table fields with baseline, non-default and SPEC-default values
Expected firmware-table exposure and OS/diagnostic consumer behavior
Console/operator, capture method and alternate BMC/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or guess an engineering debug endpoint.
Confirm the endpoint/resource is not shared with the sole production console or another host.
Do not send input or disclose diagnostic data unless explicitly approved.
Maintain an alternate recovery/diagnostic path before changing routing or table publication.
Stop on wrong routing, missing diagnostics, boot or management loss.
Restore the final state and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Collect approved read-only firmware-table metadata, endpoint output and OS/BMC health evidence.
Compare BIOS and endpoint/table captures against the approved matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, send unapproved debug input, infer vendor-private table semantics or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Obtain/approve the platform-specific debug field/table/endpoint matrix and recovery.
Perform/capture non-default persistence and default-restoration phases.
Evaluate firmware-table, routing and diagnostic evidence and set the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent execution of the BIOS UI. No source command exists; table dumps or endpoint capture may support evidence only after the platform identifies the exact table/resource.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the firmware page operation and add approved read-only table metadata and mapped endpoint capture; do not substitute OS debug settings or generic serial output.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source AMD two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains source wording but is not an executable method.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each approved BIOS field to expected table presence/content class, endpoint resource and diagnostic consumer; capture BIOS values plus read-only firmware-table and endpoint evidence at baseline, non-default persistence, default restoration and final state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact AMD board/BIOS debug-table implementation and mapped endpoint.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/CPU/BIOS/vendor firmware, BMC, OS and table/capture-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor Debug Port Table Configuration specification and project endpoint map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds table/endpoint causality and ownership controls while preserving the original firmware transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; successful setting persistence is not misreported as proof of usable debug output unless the endpoint evidence exists.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Platform table semantics, endpoint/resource mapping, defaults and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The menu label alone does not identify the exact table format or transport; no specific table name should be inferred without vendor documentation.

project_override_considerations: The project selects the exact table/endpoint and permitted capture. Results apply only to that implementation and cannot be generalized to every firmware debug transport.
expected_evidence: Platform/firmware identity, approval, endpoint map and alternate recovery
First save/reboot persistence plus table/endpoint evidence
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and diagnostic/boot health
Final debug routing, management health, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require persistence and default restoration. Missing table and endpoint definitions are execution-readiness inputs rather than contradictory facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The firmware-setting intent is clear. Vendor-private table details gate safe execution but do not permanently block the Master Library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with manual classification and adds table/endpoint-specific evidence and recovery boundaries.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains platform revision, endpoint ownership and recovery controls while applying V3.1 readiness semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Avoids inventing a table standard and distinguishes setting persistence from diagnostic-path function.

review_improvement: Prevents a vendor-private debug control from being treated as generic serial redirection and requires correlation between firmware values, table publication and the owned endpoint.
independent_technical_reasoning: Core firmware manipulation and value observation require human setup interaction, so MANUAL ONLY applies. Automated table dumps can corroborate downstream behavior but cannot replace the BIOS acceptance path.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat debug-table changes, endpoint input, reboot or default load after any routing/table/boot anomaly; preserve first-transition evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
